visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating hero carousel. Each slide is a full-width background photo with a white content card overlaid on the lower-left containing a heading, description, and a single CTA button. Prev/next circular arrow controls and a row of dot indicators.
contentPattern: One row per slide, two cells: cell 1 = slide image, cell 2 = heading + description + CTA link.
usage: Homepage hero carousel with 3 slides (WKND Adventures / San Diego Surf Spots / Downhill Skiing Wyoming).
